mapper.sql: FROM sys_org org INNER JOIN sys_tenant tenant ON tenant.id = org.tenant_id AND tenant.tenant_status = 1 AND tenant.del_flag = 0 WHERE org.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND org.org_status = 1 AND org.del_flag = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT org.id, org.parent_id, org.org_name
AND org.id IN #{orgId}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY org.id
